The plate is about 26 cm across, including the rim. The steak pieces together cover roughly 10 cm by 8 cm. There are four slices, each about 8-9 cm long, 2.5-3 cm wide, and 1 cm thick.

Each slice is about 8.5 × 2.7 × 1 ≈ 23 cm³, which is roughly 24 g. Four slices, with the end piece smaller, come to about 80 g total.

Grilled steak such as flank or skirt runs about 2 kcal/g, so 80 g is roughly 160 kcal.
